Our client has specified that they are not seeking suggestions on actual configurations of furniture and resources, i.e., floor plans. Rather, they are looking for the benefits and disbenefits of a range of possibilities, and general recommendations supported by theory and data.
Further, the analysis is based on local conditions and dynamics, and is not to be extrapolated to speculate on the firm’s overseas offices. This is because due to operational and cultural heterogeneity, the conclusions we gather in our focus groups may not hold for overseas employees.

Project definition
Project goal
The objective of our project is to use academic theory and primary data to propose a framework that will help our client answer three key questions:
What can be done to improve the working-from-home experience of Mott MacDonald’s employees?
What can be done to improve the office experience of Mott MacDonald’s employees?
What is the optimum blend of working-from-home and office work for Mott Macdonald in a post-pandemic world?
